source_image_corrections.translation: I CERTIFY, for the appropriate purposes, that under Act No. 12.928 of 17.06.97, issued by the Most Excellent Minister-President of the Honorable SUPERIOR TRIBUNAL MILITAR and published in the DJ of 20.06.97, DRA. ZILAH MARIA CALLADO FADUL PETERSEN, Judge-Auditor of the Auditoria of the 11th CJM, was summoned to assume the full duties of Judge-Auditor Inspector of Military Justice from July 02 to 31, 1997, replacing the incumbent, who is on vacation. The foregoing is true, and I attest to it. Brasília/DF, July 28, 1997. I, [signature] (Dra. Vera Regina Saliba Alves Branco), Director of the Secretariat.
